name: AdOrderSpotLogManager
tagline: Book, place, pre-empt and make good broadcast ad spots – one Power Platform app for ad sales and traffic.
description: A complete broadcast ad sales and traffic module as a PCF code component: ad orders with delivery tracking, a spot list, a break-by-break spot log with capacity and product-category separation rules, drag-and-drop placement, log locking, pre-emptions with makegood suggestions in an equal-or-better daypart, credits and airtime confirmations. Works instantly with demo data in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Break structure, dayparts and rate card as simple lists
Capacity and separation rules (enforced or warning)
Drag-and-drop and pick-and-place placement with fit indicators
Re-order spots in a break, lock logs
Makegood suggestions inside a window, credits, history
Order delivery %, states and airtime confirmation (JSON/CSV)
Bulk status moves with undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events, phone layout, keyboard and ARIA
